messages.content: You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Amiya controls Hancock, Ghoulish Mayor and casts Phantasmal Image, choosing to copy Hancock, Ghoulish Mayor. When Phantasmal Image dies, what happens?

When Phantasmal Image dies it will trigger undying and will return to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. For 'dies' triggers the game will look at the permanent before it died to determine if they trigger or not. Phantasmal Image had undying before it went to the graveyard and so it'll trigger. (603.10a) As it enters the battlefield Amiya will have the option to choose what creature it will copy. (614.1c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Andi controls Athreos, God of Passage and has 5 devotion to white and black. They cast Sakashima the Impostor. Can they copy Athreos, God of Passage?
No. Andi must choose a creature that's on the battlefield immediately before Sakashima the Impostor enters (614.12a), at which point Athreos, God of Passage isn't a creature.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Abdiel controls Eye of the Storm and casts Stoke Genius. After Eye of the Storm's triggered ability resolves, they cast Carbonize. What happens?

Before Carbonize resolves, Eye of the Storm's triggered ability exiles it. However it won't cast Stoke Genius since it isn't an instant or a sorcery card in exile. (715.4) Eye of the Storm will however exile and then copy Carbonize as normal. (Abdiel won't be able to cast the normal half of Stoke Genius from exile, because it didn't resolve and the effect putting it in exile does not allow their to cast it from there. (715.3d))
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nylah controls a Containment Priest. Aydin plays a Dryad Arbor. What happens?
It's a nontoken creature and it wasn't cast (305.1), so it's exiled. It does not enter the battlefield. (614.6) Aydin may not play another land this turn.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Alex controls Anax, Hardened in the Forge and Runaway Steam-Kin with three +1/1 counters and one damage marked on it. Alex removes three counters to cast Onakke Ogre and Runaway Steam-Kin dies. How many Satyr tokens does Alex get?

One. Alex removes the counters from Runaway Steam-Kin and when state-based actions are checked Runaway Steam-Kin has one toughness and one damage marked on it, causing it to die. (704.5g) Anax, Hardened in the Forge's trigger will check to see what Runaway Steam-Kin looked like right before it died, and at that point it had one power. (608.2h)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariadne exiles Thelonite Hermit from the top of their library with Goblin Researcher. Can they cast it as a face down morph creature?

Yes. Morph works from any zone from which a player may play a card. (702.37a). Goblin Researcher simply gives permission to cast the card without imposing an alternative cost, so an alternative cost like morph can be used. (118.9).
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariel controls a token that's a copy of Golgari Brownscale created by Electroduplicate. They cast Slay to destroy Golgari Brownscale. Can Ariel dredge the token? If so, what happens?

The token is put into the graveyard just like any other permanent (111.6), and it has dredge while it's there. However Golgari Brownscale can't leave the graveyard (111.8), so Ariel can't choose to dredge it. (702.52a, 608.2d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ashley crews their Getaway Car. Nasir activates their Cave of the Frost Dragon causing it to become a creature. After that resolves, Nasir casts Mirrorweave targeting their Cave of the Frost Dragon. What are Getaway Car's characteristics after Mirrorweave resolves?

It's a 0/0 colorless land artifact creature with no subtypes and the abilities of Cave of the Frost Dragon.

When Getaway Car becomes a copy of Cave of the Frost Dragon, it copies only the copiable values of the permanent, which does not include continuous effects like the one turning Cave of the Frost Dragon into a creature. (707.2)

The effect from crew is still making Getaway Car an artifact creature ([702.122a]), but it doesn't define a power and toughness, so the game treats it as 0/0. (208.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Autumn casts Cauldron's Gift spending three black mana while their graveyard has no cards in it. As it resolves, Happy Hogan, Dauntless Driver is put into the graveyard from the library. Can Autumn choose to return it to the battlefield with Cauldron's Gift?

Yes. As spells and abilities resolve, the instructions are carried out in the order they are printed on the card. (608.2c) Autumn first takes the top four cards of their library and puts them into their graveyard, then chooses which creature they would like to return. The choice of which creature to return is made upon resolution. (608.2d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nehemiah controls Pharika's Chosen and 3 Headless Horsemans. Ana casts Alpha Brawl, targeting Pharika's Chosen. Which creatures survive?
None of them. Pharika's Chosen has deathtouch, and so kills all of the Headless Horsemans. (702.2b) The Headless Horsemans deal enough damage to the Pharika's Chosen that it dies as well.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Adeline casts Living Death while they control Immortal Coil and Walking Corpse. The only card in their graveyard is a Cheeky House-Mouse. Does Adeline lose the game? If so, could they avoid this by countering Immortal Coil's trigger with Voidslime?

Adeline will lose the game unless they castVoidslime. The first step in Living Death's resolution is to exile all creature cards from graveyards. At this point, Immortal Coil will trigger because Adeline has no cards in their graveyard. (603.8) Although sacrificing Walking Corpse will ultimately put a creature card there before this trigger is put on the stack, it still will go on the stack and resolve. (603.3). Immortal Coil has a state trigger, therefore, there will only be one instance of this triggered ability on the stack. (603.8) After Living Death resolves, Adeline can Voidslime Immortal Coil's ability and it won't be put on the stack again because they now have cards in their graveyard.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ainsley and Angela are playing 2HG. Ainsley attacks with Earth Elemental and Angela casts Blind with Anger to gain control of Earth Elemental after it's been declared as an attacker in the declare attackers step. Is it still attacking?

No. A creature that changes controllers is removed from combat. (506.4) Even though Ainsley and Angela are on the same team and are both allowed to be attacking with creatures, they are different players (810.5) and therefore Angela gaining control of Ainsley's creature still qualifies as a control change.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alonzo controls Oreskos Swiftclaw merged with Regal Leosaur on top. They then cast Evil Twin choosing to copy the merged permanent. Will the mutate trigger occur?
No. A mutate trigger only occurs as a result of a mutating creature spell merging with a creature. ([702.140d])
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ari controls Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Chains of Mephistopheles. On Ari's turn, Nash has four cards in hand and casts Brainstorm. What happens as Brainstorm resolves?

Nash discards a card and then draws a card. Then Nash puts 2 cards from their hand on the top of their library.

Cards are drawn one at a time. (121.2) For Nash's first draw, Leovold, Emissary of Trest doesn't apply, since it's their first draw this turn, so Chains of Mephistopheles applies and makes them discard and then draw. Now they've drawn a card this turn, so Leovold, Emissary of Trest is "active". Their next two draws can't occur, so Chains of Mephistopheles's replacement effect is never applied. (614.17c) Then they finish resolving Brainstorm by putting two cards from their hand on top of their library.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Avalyn controls Obelisk of Urd enchanted with Disruption Aura. Can Avalyn tap six creatures instead of paying mana for Disruption Aura's triggered ability?

No. Convoke is an ability that functions while Obelisk of Urd is on the stack that allows Avalyn to tap creatures instead of paying mana for the Obelisk of Urd. (702.51a) It does not modify the mana cost of the spell in other zones, nor does it allow Avalyn to tap creatures to pay for Disruption Aura.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ainsley controls a Hyena Pack and a Deathrite Shaman. Nicholas controls a Sphere of Safety. Can Ainsley use Deathrite Shaman's ability to pay for the Hyena Pack to attack?

No. Sphere of Safety imposes a cost on Hyena Pack attacking, which must be paid as a part of declaring it as an attacker. (508.1g) Deathrite Shaman's ability is not a mana ability (605.1a), so the last time it could be activated before attackers are declared is during the beginning of combat step. (506.1) At the end of that step, the mana would empty from Ainsley's mana pool. (500.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Alexandra activates the [-2] ability of Grist, the Hunger Tide, intending to sacrifice their 1/1 Insect token to destroy Nico's Bolg, Erebor's Reckoning. Can Nico kill the Insect in order to save their Bolg, Erebor's Reckoning?

Yes, but only before knowing that Bolg, Erebor's Reckoning is the target. When Alexandra activates Grist, the Hunger Tide, Nico can respond by killing the Insect. (602.2) If Alexandra doesn't sacrifice a creature when Grist, the Hunger Tide's ability resolves, there won't be any trigger to destroy a creature or planeswalker. But once that trigger is on the stack targeting Bolg, Erebor's Reckoning, the Insect is already in the graveyard. (603.12)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Arjun controls a Chalice of the Void with 2 charge counters. Arjun casts Cryptic Trilobite with X=1.will Cryptic Trilobite be countered?
Yes Cryptic Trilobite will get countered. Since X=1, the mana value of this spell is 2 (202.3e) which causes of Chalice of the Void's ability to trigger.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alaya would like to choose colorless for Temple of the Dragon Queen. Can they?
No. Colorless is not a color. (105.2c/105.1/105.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nick controls a Parallel Lives. Armani casts Sprout. In response, Nick casts Gather Specimens. Who creates how many tokens?

Nick creates 2 tokens. At first there is no effect that modifies how the tokens are created, so the effect from Gather Specimens that modifies how they enter the battlefield is applied. Now that they are entering under Nick's control, Parallel Lives's effect becomes applicable (616.2) and modifies how they are created. It doesn't matter that Parallel Lives applies to the creation of the tokens while Gather Specimens applies to them entering the battlefield- it's still the same event. (701.7)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Can Blitz Automaton be part of a Nyla, Shirshu Sleuth commander deck?
No. The color identity of Blitz Automaton is red (903.4), and cannot be put in a nonred commander deck. (903.5c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nathaly controls Pithing Needle naming "Lightning Storm". Can Ashley cast Lightning Storm? If so, can they discard land cards to put charge counters on it?
Ashley can cast Lightning Storm, but cannot discard a land card to put charge counters on it. Discarding a land card is an activated ability, while casting a spell is not. (113.3b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nico controls Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir. Can Austin cast their Bloodhall Priest for its madness cost during their main phase when they discard it?
No. Casting a card for its madness cost is part of resolving the madness trigger (702.35a), which is not normally a legal time to cast a sorcery. (307.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariah controls Wall of Wood and casts Biting Tether targeting Nico's Zilortha, Strength Incarnate. In response, Nico casts Cinderclasm to deal 1 damage to Wall of Wood. What happens to Wall of Wood?

Wall of Wood is destroyed after Biting Tether resolves, before any player gets priority. Damage from Cinderclasm indeed remains marked on Wall of Wood until end of turn (120.6) and the game checks to see if it is lethal each time state-based actions are checked. (704.3, 704.5, 704.5g)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariel casts Metamorphic Alteration targeting Nico's Spider-Ham, Peter Porker, choosing to copy Nico's Misty Knight, Hero for Hire. What happens?

Spider-Ham, Peter Porker becomes a copy of Misty Knight, Hero for Hire. Misty Knight, Hero for Hire's name is copied and therefore due to the legend rule, Nico will need to choose one to put into their graveyard. (707.2, 704.5j)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Amia casts Desperate Ritual and would like to use the mana it generates to splice another Desperate Ritual onto it. Can they do this?

No. Amia chooses whether they are splicing anything onto Desperate Ritual and then pays its cost as Desperate Ritual is cast. (702.47, 601.2b, 601.2h) It only resolves and adds {R}{R}{R} afterwards. (608.1/601.2)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Alaina controls Mikaeus, the Unhallowed and Cateran Overlord. They take control of Nico's commander, Arahbo, the First Fang, using Involuntary Employment and sacrifices it to activate Cateran Overlord's ability. Could Nico choose to return Arahbo, the First Fang to the command zone before the undying trigger returns it to the battlefield?

Yes. Before the undying trigger is put on the stack, state-based actions are checked. (704.3/117.5) At this point, Nico could choose to put Arahbo, the First Fang in the command zone as a state-based action. (704.6d/903.9a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nico controls Vedalken Orrery. Antonio casts Temporal Manipulation. After it resolves, Nico casts Ugin's Nexus. Antonio passes the turn. Who takes the next turn?

Nico will take the next turn. Ugin's Nexus generates a replacement effect that will replace Antonio taking an extra turn with them not taking an extra turn. (614.1a) It doesn't matter that Ugin's Nexus was cast after Temporal Manipulation was resolved, only that it is on the battlefield at the time the extra turn would begin.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ansley controls Tobias Andrion, a token copy of Tobias Andrion produced by Twinflame, a 1/1 Saproling token created by Sprout Swarm, Hinterland Scourge, and a token copy of Hinterland Scourge produced by Stolen Identity. Nicolas casts Ratchet Bomb and activates its second ability. As Ratchet Bomb's ability resolves, what is destroyed?

The Saproling token and the token copy of Hinterland Scourge. Copy effects copy mana cost (707.2), so the token Tobias Andrion doesn't have a mana value of 0. Tokens that are created by an effect that sets their characteristics only have those characteristics. The Saproling token has no mana cost, so its mana value is 0. The mana value of transformed transforming double-faced cards is determined by their front face (712.8e), so the Hinterland Scourge isn't destroyed. Copies of double-faced cards have a mana value of 0. (712.8e)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Nico controls Pardic Wanderer. Arthur casts Infernal Grasp targeting Pardic Wanderer. In response, Nico casts Siren's Ruse targeting Pardic Wanderer. After everything has resolved, is Pardic Wanderer on the battlefield?

Yes. When Siren's Ruse resolves and returns Pardic Wanderer to the battlefield, it becomes a completely new object that's unrelated to the old one. (400.7) When Infernal Grasp tries to resolve, its target doesn't exist anymore, so it's just put into the graveyard. (608.2b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Addison controls Erratic Apparition and casts Impending Doom targeting their Thornhide Wolves. Before that resolves, Noemi destroys Thornhide Wolves. Will Impending Doom trigger Constellation?

No. On the stack an Aura is a targeted spell. (303.4a) If all of its targets are illegal before it resolves, it will be removed from the stack, and will not resolve, nor will it enter the battlefield. (303.4g, 608.3a, 608.3d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Aryana controls Xathrid Gorgon. Nikolai controls a Mister Hyde, Monster Within and Dragonsoul Knight. Aryana activates Xathrid Gorgon to put a petrification counter on Dragonsoul Knight which Nikolai removes with Mister Hyde, Monster Within. Can Nikolai activate Dragonsoul Knight's activated ability?

No, Nikolai cannot activate Dragonsoul Knight's ability. This is because the changes made by Xathrid Gorgon's ability are a continuous effect. (611.2a) The petrification counter serves only as a reminder of the changes and is not dependent on the counter. Dragonsoul Knight will remain a defender that cannot activate it's abilities for the rest of the game. (602.5, 613.1f)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Axel control Viscera Seer, Hateful Eidolon, and Pillarfield Ox enchanted by Blessing of the Nephilim. Axel activated Viscera Seer's ability sacrificing Pillarfield Ox to do so. This triggers Hateful Eidolon. In what order can Axel resolve these abilities?

Axel must draw then scry 1.

To activate Viscera Seer's ability, Axel puts that ability on the stack and pays the costs, sacrificing Pillarfield Ox in this case. (602.2) This triggers the ability of Hateful Eidolon. This triggered ability is then put onto the stack. Since the stack resolves in a first-in-last-out order, Axel must resolve the triggered ability then the activated ability in that order. (405.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aydan casts False Dawn. After it resolves, they tap a Seat of the Synod for mana. What color of mana does it produce?
{W}. Seat of the Synod's ability to add mana is controlled by Aydan. (109.4a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Arian manifests the top card of their library with Soul Summons. Then, they mutate Majestic Auricorn targeting the manifested creature. What are the characteristics of the resulting creature if Arian chooses to put the manifested creature on top?

It is a 2/2 colorless face-down creature with no abilities. It is face-down because the topmost object is face-down (729.2e), and this status defines its characteristics. (708.2, 613.2a, 613.2b) This notably means that Majestic Auricorn's triggered ability won't trigger.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alanna casts Sram's Expertise. As it resolves, they would like tap the tokens it created to cast Collective Effort escalated twice. Can they?

Yes. The instructions of a resolving spell are carried out in the order written (608.2c), so the tokens will be on the battlefield at that time. Tapping creatures for escalate is an additional cost. ([702.120a]) Alanna may still pay an additional cost for Collective Effort while casting it for the alternative cost given to it by Sram's Expertise. (118.9d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Allan cast Diabolic Tutor. Before that resolves Nico cast Opposition Agent. When Diabolic Tutor resolves, can Nico look at Allan's hand?
Yes. Players are allowed to review their hands while searching their libraries, so Nico is allowed to look at Allan's hand. (722.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aarush controls Asmodeus the Archfiend and, during their draw step, they attempt to dredge Darkblast. What happens?

Aarush can dredge Darkblast instead of drawing. There are two replacement effects attempting to replace Aarush's draw. Since they are the affected player, they choose whether to exile the card with Asmodeus the Archfiend or dredge with Darkblast. (616.1) Once one of the replacement effects has been applied, the "draw" event no longer exists (614.6), and the other replacement effect does not apply. (614.7)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Albert, Bailey, and Christine are playing a multiplayer game. Bailey controls Emissary of Grudges. Albert casts Cruel Entertainment to take control of Bailey's next turn. After Bailey begins their turn, can Albert see which player was chosen for the Emissary of Grudges?

No. The choice was made as Emissary of Grudges entered the battlefield, which already happened- it's no longer visible to Bailey. (722.4) Albert can choose to activate the ability (at which point all players will know who was chosen), but otherwise the choice is not visible to any player.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Asa controls a Suncleanser that targeted Venser's Sliver when it entered the battlefield. Asa casts Boneyard Parley, putting Phylactery Lich and Thorn-Thrash Viashino onto the battlefield. Can they choose to sacrifice Suncleanser to the Thorn-Thrash Viashino and put a phylactery counter on Venser's Sliver?

No. Phylactery Lich and Thorn-Thrash Viashino enter the battlefield at the same time. Even if Asa chooses to sacrifice Suncleanser as Thorn-Thrash Viashino enters, its effect existed immediately before the Phylactery Lich entered the battlefield, so Venser's Sliver can't have the counter placed on it. (614.17a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Annie controls Strangleroot Geist enchanted by their Fool's Demise. They attack with it and Nico blocks with Cowl Prowler. Will Strangleroot Geist have a +1/+1 counter when it returns to the battlefield?

It's Annie's choice. There are two triggers when Strangleroot Geist dies (702.93a), so Annie can choose the order to put them onto the stack. (603.3b) The first one to resolve will return the Strangleroot Geist to the battlefield, and the second one will do nothing.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn controls Paladin of Atonement with 3 +1/+1 counters on it. They attacks with it and Nixon blocks with Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant. How much life does Autumn gain?

4. Even though it's a 1/1 in the graveyard, the game cares about its toughness when it was last on the battlefield. (603.10a, 608.2h) Damage from Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant didn't reduce Paladin of Atonement's toughness, it just caused that much damage to be marked on it, which caused it to die. (120.3e)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Norah controls Angler Turtle and Ghostly Prison. Ariel pays {2} to attack Norah. Does their Firkraag, Cunning Instigator trigger?
Yes. Costs to attack are locked in before the game checks to see if any triggers would happen due to attackers being declared. (508.1h/508.1j/508.1m)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aron casts Deadly Embrace targeting Nico's Dryad Militant. In which zone is Deadly Embrace after resolution?

In Aron's graveyard. Putting Deadly Embrace into Aron's graveyard is the last part of its resolution. (608.2n) It therefore happens after Dryad Militant has already been destroyed and is no longer on the battlefield, its effect does not apply anymore. (604.2)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Arlo controls two Ruin Crabs and plays a land. Can they cast Extirpate targeting something in the first three cards milled, before the next three are milled?
Yes. Ruin Crab has a triggered ability (113.3c), which each resolve one at a time. (405.5/117.4) Players may cast spells in between. (117.3b, 117.1a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Addison controls Angel's Tomb and no other creatures. They cast Deadeye Navigator. Can they pair it with Angel's Tomb?

No. Soulbond is a triggered ability that will only go on the stack if Addison controls another eligible creature when Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield. However, before Angel's Tomb's ability resolves, Addison doesn't control any other eligible creatures. (702.95a, 603.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Adley enchants their Prismatic Vista with Abundant Growth. Next turn, Nico casts Zhao, the Moon Slayer. What colors of mana can Prismatic Vista tap for?

Any color. Zhao, the Moon Slayer operates in the type-changing layer (613.1d) which is applied before the ability adding and removing layer. (613.1f) Prismatic Vista is a Mountain, with the additional ability "{T}: Add one mana of any color.".
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Averie casts Biomantic Mastery targeting Brooks and Corey. Before that resolves Brooks casts Ral's Outburst, which deals lethal damage to Corey and causes them to lose the game. What will happen when Biomantic Mastery resolves?
Averie will draw cards equal to the creatures controlled by Brooks upon the time of resolution. (608.2h) Averie will not draw any cards for Corey as they are now an illegal target. (608.2b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Noelle controls Patchwork Gnomes. Aryan casts Austere Command choosing the modes "Destroy all creatures with mana value 3 or less." and "Destroy all artifacts." In response Noelle activates Patchwork Gnomes's regenerate ability on itself. What will happen when Austere Command resolves?

Patchwork Gnomes will be destroyed. Regeneration is a replacement effect that prevents the object from being destroyed the next time it would be this turn. (701.19a/614.8) In this case the regeneration shield set up by Noelle will prevent Patchwork Gnomes from being destroyed as an artifact. However when Austere Command goes to destroy all creatures with mana value 3 or less, Patchwork Gnomes is no longer protected by a regeneration shield, as it was used up in the first half of the spell, and will be destroyed at that time.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Alaya and Nelson are starting a two-player game. Alaya is going first and has Serum Powder in their starting hand, which they would like to use. Do they have to declare that they're using it before Nelson chooses whether to mulligan?
Yes. Serum Powder's ability must be declared at the same time as Alaya would declare if they are mulliganing. (103.5b) Alaya must announce that decision before Nelson does. (103.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Agustin has Sivitri Scarzam and two Ichorids in their graveyard. On their upkeep, they resolve the trigger of the first Ichorid, exiling the second Ichorid. As the second trigger resolves, can Agustin choose to exile the Sivitri Scarzam? If so, what happens?
No. If Ichorid isn't in the graveyard when the trigger begins to resolve, it is removed from the stack. (603.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ana plays Shrapnel Slinger while controlling Icingdeath, Frost Tyrant, and Nico doesn't control any artifacts. Can Ana still sacrifice Icingdeath, Frost Tyrant?

Yes. Shrapnel Slinger has one trigger that lets Ana sacrifice a creature, and a reflexive trigger that destroys an artifact. (603.12) If the reflexive trigger doesn't have a target, it doesn't go on the stack, but the original trigger doesn't require a target. (603.3d)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

At the beginning of the game, Avery announced Obosh, the Preypiercer as their companion. During the game, Avery cast Wintermoor Commander from their sideboard with Wish. Later, Avery restarts the game with Karn Liberated. What happens?

Wintermoor Commander will be shuffled into Avery's library along with the rest of the cards in the game. (726.2) Because Wintermoor Commander violates Obosh, the Preypiercer's companion restriction, Avery can't announce it as their companion for the restarted game. (103.2b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Andrew controls Skill Borrower and Sensei's Divining Top. The top card of their library is a Putrid Leech. Andrew activates Skill Borrower's ability, then activates Sensei's Divining Top's first ability, choosing to put Putrid Leech second from the top. Then they activate Sensei's Divining Top again, putting Putrid Leech back on top. Can Andrew activate Skill Borrower's ability again?

Yes. Putrid Leech stopped being revealed for a time, so it is no longer the same object that it was before. (401.6) Skill Borrower has a new ability that just has the same text as the ability that was activated earlier. (602.5c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariel controls Omniscience. Without paying any mana, can they cast Ertai's Meddling targeting Zuran Orb?
No. When casting a spell without paying its mana cost, X must be 0. (107.3b) Since 0 isn't a legal choice for Ertai's Meddling, it can't be cast this way.
